rationale: Trump fired all sitting members of the National Labor Relations Board, leaving it without a quorum and unable to decide pending worker complaints. The board enforces federal rights to organize, so disabling it affected workers and employers nationwide. Legal scholars said the members could be removed only for cause, raising a serious concern about executive interference with an independent agency; the supplied account does not report a final judicial ruling or how long the board remained inoperative.
basis: The firings occurred in late February 2025 and left the NLRB unable to function while millions of complaints awaited action, according to the entry.
